name: Lying Side Lateral Raise
instructions: Lie on your side on a bench or the floor, holding a light dumbbell in your top hand at your side.
Raise the dumbbell out and up until your arm is above shoulder level.
longevityNotes: Pressing strength keeps daily pushing — doors, shelves, getting up from the floor — easy and safe. Controlled pressing builds the shoulders, chest, and arms that protect you in a fall.
overview: A side-lying lateral raise that isolates the side delt through a different angle of resistance.

safetyNotes: Use a very light weight; stop with shoulder pain.
